blocks.text: A group of executives, including those from First Gen, pushing for net zero aims to secure stronger government backing to ensure the Philippines stays competitive. Allan Barcena, executive director of the Net Zero Carbon Alliance (NZCA), said the group has been “aggressive” in forging tie-ups with the private sector and government agencies.
